title: Conditional Diffusion Generation of DVL and Inertial Signals for Underwater Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2610.34574v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) navigate without satellite positioning and rely on Doppler velocity log (DVL) and inertial sensors for motion estimation. Deep learning methods for processing these sensors require training data covering the motion the AUV encounters, commonly obtained through costly sea trials. To overcome this limitation, we present a conditional diffusion framework that generates synthetic DVL and inertial signals to replace real recordings in training. The generator employs an Elucidated diffusion model conditioned on three per-channel motion descriptors. Three configurations are evaluated: DVL beams alone, inertial channels alone, and all channels jointly from one model. translated_title: 面向水下导航的DVL与惯性信号条件扩散生成
translated_abstract: 自主水下航行器（AUV）在没有卫星定位的情况下进行导航，依赖多普勒速度仪（DVL）和惯性传感器进行运动估计。处理这些传感器的深度学习方法需要覆盖AUV所遇到的各种运动的训练数据，而这些数据通常需要通过昂贵的海上试验获得。为克服这一局限，我们提出了一种条件扩散框架，可以生成合成的DVL和惯性信号，用于在训练中替代真实记录。该生成器采用以三个逐通道运动描述符为条件的Elucidated扩散模型。研究评估了三种配置：仅生成DVL波束信号、仅生成惯性通道信号，以及由单一模型联合生成所有通道。在真实数据集的十三条轨迹上的实验表明，生成的信号以0.72至0.997之间的皮尔逊相关系数遵循所要求的运动条件，并且能够迁移到生成器训练中未包含的轨迹上，同时不会复制任何训练数据。
tldr: 该论文提出一种条件扩散生成框架，可生成符合指定运动条件的合成DVL与惯性信号，用以替代昂贵的海试数据来训练水下导航深度学习模型，生成信号与真实数据的相关系数达0.72至0.997并具备良好的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a conditional diffusion framework that generates synthetic DVL and inertial signals conditioned on motion descriptors, enabling training of underwater navigation deep learning models without costly sea trials, with Pearson correlations of 0.72–0.997 and good generalization to unseen trajectories.
